subject: Re: Kickoff: DualDICE for off-policy evaluation
body:
Ximena,

Staffing: Halima leads the method work and owns the GridWalk validation matrix (tabular and non-tabular, per the release's run configurations); Farah does the toolkit module and API; Oyin owns the data plumbing for the internal pilot and the productionization runway.

On your follow-on staffing ask — settled it with Oyin and her lead this morning: Oyin is committed at 60% to this project for May 2026 to carry the productionization phase, with the remaining 40% on her platform maintenance duties. I've logged that in the allocation sheet so nobody grabs her for Q2 firefighting.

Compute is a non-issue — GridWalk runs are laptop-scale, the pilot is a few dozen CPU-heavy jobs, nothing needing reservations.

One process item: the internal logged dataset touches partner data, so I'm filing the privacy review this week given their 2-3 week SLA — it must clear before the April 10 pilot.

Bruno
